intro: Practice AI-103 ideas with design activities and a model deployment task.

labs.title: Design a RAG solution
labs.summary: Order the RAG steps and choose the right technique.
labs.scenario: Show you understand when to use prompting, RAG, fine-tuning and agents.

activities.title: RAG pipeline
activities.prompt: Order the steps of a RAG solution.
items: Store them in a vector index
Embed the user question and retrieve matches
Add the retrieved text to the prompt

items.text: Answer questions using the latest internal policy PDFs
Make replies follow a strict brand voice consistently across thousands of calls
Return JSON in a given format
Look up an order, then issue a refund after approval

rows.label: Lower this setting for more deterministic output
Azure service commonly used as the vector index

hints: Fresh private data points to retrieval.
Behavior and style point to fine-tuning.
labs.review: Try prompting first, add RAG for knowledge, and fine-tune only when behavior still needs to change.

labs.title: Choose the Azure AI service
labs.summary: Match scenarios to vision, language and extraction capabilities.
labs.scenario: Pick the capability that fits each requirement.

items.text: Read the text on a photographed sign
Locate each forklift in warehouse images
Score customer reviews as positive or negative
Pull company names and dates from articles
Extract the total and vendor from invoices
Convert a support article to French

rows.label: Rectangle marking where an object is (two words)
The goal expressed by a user utterance
Search component that runs AI enrichment while indexing (one word)

hints: Decide whether the input is image, text, audio or a form.
labs.review: Picking the specialized service for the input type is usually simpler than prompting a general model.

labs.title: Deploy a model and set safety
labs.summary: Configure a model deployment and its content filter.
labs.scenario: In project support-bot, create a deployment named chat-prod from model gpt-4o-mini using the Standard deployment type with 50 thousand tokens per minute. Attach content filter Strict, and turn on Managed identity authentication. Save each page.

tasks.text: Deployment chat-prod uses gpt-4o-mini, Standard type, 50K TPM
Strict content filter and managed identity on

hints: Quota is set per deployment, in thousands of tokens per minute.
Managed identity removes API keys from the app.
labs.review: A deployment pairs a model with capacity and safety settings. Entra-based access with managed identity is preferred over keys.
